verdict.rationale: Jules can be assigned tasks (via GitHub issue label or API) to fix bugs and open PRs, and its API explicitly supports building 'custom workflows' and 'automate bug fixing' with automationMode for auto-PR creation, which could underpin a CI-failure-fix pipeline. However, there is no direct evidence of a built-in CI failure detection/trigger integration (e.g., watching GitHub Actions runs) — this would have to be custom-built via the API rather than an out-of-box feature. Missing for 10: documented CI-failure trigger/integration, evidence of automatic diagnosis of failed workflow logs, and a case study demonstrating end-to-end CI-fix PRs.
